tools.name: sanctions_lists_metadata
tools.description: Free. Returns which sanctions lists are loaded, the data version, and the record count. Use this to decide whether the data is fresh enough for your purpose before screening.

tools.name: screen_name
tools.description: Free tier: limited to a small daily quota per client. Screens one person or entity name against the combined OFAC SDN, EU Consolidated and UN Consolidated lists using a 4-tier match pipeline (exact / alias / fuzzy / fuzzy-alias). Returns ranked candidates with match_type, confidence and scoring brea

tools.name: screen_batch
tools.description: Paid: $0.02 per call (up to 100 names), paid via x402 in USDC on Base. No free quota. Use this for onboarding batches rather than looping screen_name. Returns one result object per name, aggregated hit counts, and a screening id for your audit trail.

tools.name: screen_ownership_50pct
tools.description: Paid: $0.05 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base. STATUS: planned, not yet available. Checks whether an entity is blocked by operation of the OFAC 50 Percent Rule (owned 50% or more, in the aggregate, by designated persons) even when it does not itself appear on any list. Requires beneficial-owne
